title: Retrieve a covered service cartridge while protecting a nearby container
instruction: Place the red service cartridge on the green mat, released and stable. Restore all other movable equipment to its starting arrangement. Keep the yellow container upright and within 5 mm of its starting position. Work cooperatively with both arms; choose their roles from the scene. Use only the grippers, with no tools or improvised supports.
context: De-energized equipment maintenance combines access planning, cooperative handling and protection of nearby containers. The model must identify relevant obstructions from observations. This fixed-layout prototype does not yet establish that two arms are physically necessary or demonstrate general occlusion reasoning.
setup: Fixed station layout, no jitter. World axes: x forward, y left, z up, metres; table top T=0.7475 m. Each item uses explicit type / size / material labels; materials describe surrogates, not measured coefficients. Table: type=Box, size=1.10 x 1.30 x 0.06 m, material=oak-coloured rigid tabletop surrogate. cover: type=Box, size=0.18 x 0.07 x 0.02 m, material=rigid plastic, blue, mass=0.10 kg, centre=(0.25,0.025,T+0.07). cartridge: type=Box, size=0.04 x 0.04 x 0.04 m, material=ABS plastic, red, mass=0.08 kg, centre=(0.25,0.02,T+0.02). rail_a: type=Box, size=0.02 x 0.07 x 0.06 m, material=aluminium surrogate, fixed, centre=(0.17,0.025,T+0.03). rail_b: type=Box, size=0.02 x 0.07 x 0.06 m, material=aluminium surrogate, fixed, centre=(0.33,0.025,T+0.03). protected_cylinder: type=Cylinder, size=radius 0.022 m x height 0.12 m, material=sealed polymer container represented by a solid rigid surrogate, yellow, mass=0.08 kg, centre=(0.33,-0.12,T+0.06). goal_mat: type=Box, size=0.09 x 0.09 x 0.001 m, material=silicone surrogate, green, fixed, centre=(0.24,-0.20,T+0.0005). All six task objects initially have zero yaw. The cartridge has 0.02 m vertical clearance below the cover. Temporary handling region centre=(0.20,0.23,T+0.14), with no pedestal. Station fixtures: type=two YAM robot assemblies, three cameras and camera stand; size=asset-defined; material=asset-defined mixed rigid components, not independently characterized. Built-in calibrated poses and room fixtures are inherited from station; resolved dimensions, collider materials and bindings must be exported on the GPU host. The task-file adapter assigns all six task primitives static/dynamic friction 1.2/1.0 and restitution 0 by configuration default; table and fingertip materials must be inspected separately.
scoring: Development scorer; all physical thresholds remain uncalibrated. Evaluate object/robot poses at 20 Hz and each filtered fingertip/object normal force at 240 Hz (12 substeps/control step). Missing, nonfinite, negative, malformed, incomplete or reused contact batches latch score 0. Identify the support arm from measured cover contact; the extraction arm must be the other actual arm. Either assignment is allowed. A grasp requires both fingertips with per-finger force hysteresis F_on=0.5 N and F_off=0.2 N, at least 0.10 s continuous two-finger engagement, gripper opening <=0.85 and TCP within 0.03 m of the object. These new contact thresholds are estimates. Any sampled safety violation latches score 0 for the entire trial: container centre moves >0.005 m in 3D from settled start or tilts >10 degrees; cover tilt >25 degrees; cartridge tilt >30 degrees; any loose object AABB leaves x=[0.04,0.49], y=[-0.34,0.34], z=[T-0.01,T+0.30]; nonfinite state. Held cover additionally requires horizontal centre error <=0.025 m from temporary region, height error <=0.02 m, bottom >=T+0.10, tilt <=10 degrees, speed <0.02 m/s, spin <0.5 rad/s. Cartridge movement >0.01 m from settled start requires a previously verified 20-consecutive-sample cover hold and current cover hold, plus a sustained grasp by the distinct extraction arm. Cover control must continue until delivery is verified. Extraction must be observed with cartridge bottom >=T+0.085 while both arms perform their respective grasps. Going directly to the goal without that event fails. Cartridge grasp must persist until it reaches the goal region; settling after release is allowed; release in transit or leaving the goal after release begins fails. Goal pose: horizontal centre error <=0.015 m from mat centre, centre height within 0.005 m of T+0.021, bottom within 0.005 m of T+0.001, tilt <=10 degrees, speed <0.01 m/s, spin <0.5 rad/s. Delivery requires this pose, no detected fingertip contact from either arm, extraction-arm opening >=0.90 and TCP >=0.06 m from cartridge centre for 20 consecutive samples. Without violations, highest currently satisfied tier applies: 0.25 for a verified and current cover hold; 0.50 for verified extraction, current cover hold and cartridge grasp with bottom >=T+0.085; 0.75 for verified delivery and continued placement/release conditions; otherwise 0.0. Full score 1.0 additionally requires cover horizontal error <=0.01 m and vertical error <=0.005 m from nominal start, tilt <=5 degrees, speed <0.01 m/s, spin <0.5 rad/s, no detected fingertip contact from either arm, support-arm opening >=0.90 and TCP >=0.06 m from cover centre. All final conditions must hold for 20 consecutive control samples via SUCCESS_HOLD_S=1.0; score() alone returns at most 0.75.
run_limit: 2,400 control steps (120 seconds at 20 Hz; PhysX 240 Hz, 12 physics steps per control step). Stop on sustained full success or the action limit.
reset_notes: Restore every object and both robot ready poses, settle, then clear all scoring history and capture initial cartridge/container centres. Use run_task.py with object_jitter=0. The cover is loose; the supports and mat are fixed. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Unverified rigid-primitive prototype: cover is loose, not hinged; cartridge is not plugged in; container has no liquid. All task primitives share framework contact coefficients (static/dynamic friction 1.2/1.0), which are not calibrated ABS/aluminium/silicone measurements. Per-fingertip, per-object normal forces and robot state establish attributed engagement, not force closure or causal load support. The adapter is designed to collect 240 Hz contacts; body/filter mapping, actual timing and material bindings still need Isaac Sim validation. Object safety remains sampled at 20 Hz. A loose cover may admit a safe single-arm bypass; paired physical counterfactuals and potential scene redesign are required before claiming bimanual necessity. No GPU physics run or measured score/media is available.
